item.title: Version 3.1.1
item.description:
This releases fixes several bugs that could cause CedarLogic to crash occasionally. Deleting a gate can sometimes leave a wire still pointing at it, and the next simulation step then crashes the program.

Also fixed: starting a new circuit from a second tab could keep using a tab it had just closed, deleting a wire attached to a missing gate could hang the program, undoing a new tab and then redoing it worked on the wrong tab, and junction labels could quietly stop joining wires together.

Crash reports are now properly readable! The PDB file needed to decode the symbols is now properly shipped with the installer.

Recovering work after a crash is way more reliable as well now and will avoid deleting the recovery file unless you absolutely 100% save it to the old file.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/taciturnaxolotl/CedarLogic/compare/v3.1.0...v3.1.1
